summary: Training infrastructure is built and running on the training machine. The simulator is an exact copy of the engine (bit-identical in parity tests). PPO training reaches about 240M learner samples per hour. M2 (learning to score against idle opponents) is training now. In parallel: the single-file exporter, the evaluation harness and five new scripted training opponents are being built, and the Phase 1 code is under review.

milestones.title: Fast exact simulator, training harness, throughput
milestones.note: Exact engine replica; ~240M samples/h on the training machine

milestones.title: Learn to score vs idle (≥8 captures/match, ≤2 wall deaths/player)
